description: Ministry of Defence - Notify the names of Regular Navel Personnel recommended for the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal and Clasp
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively lists named individuals (naval personnel) receiving awards (Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal and Clasp). It contains personnel changes (awards) with basic titles/ranks only (e.g., LCDR, SLT, FCPO) but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) as it focuses solely on government personnel matters without detailed portfolio information.
